title: Converger Protocol v1 - shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by every frame and message schema. See docs/protocol/v1.md. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields, so no definition here forbids additional properties.

seq.description: Per-conversation, 1-based, strictly monotonic sequence number of a persistent frame (mekik/1 seq).

watermark.description: The highest persistent-frame seq a client has durably seen. 0 means 'nothing seen'.

legacyWatermark.description: Watermark as accepted during the migration window: the integer seq (canonical), its decimal string form, or a pre-v1 opaque base64url string (`seq:<n>` or a legacy activity UUID). Servers emit only the integer form in v1 frames.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC), as in mekik/1.

id.description: An opaque identifier (activity id, connection id, interrupt id). Servers mint UUIDs for activities; clients MUST NOT parse ids.

clientId.description: Client-chosen id of a send, used for the ack and for exactly-once persistence (dedupe per conversation).

from.description: Which side of the conversation produced the frame, relative to the end user. mekik/1 values only: every non-end-user sender (bot, human agent, system) is "bot". The finer role is in `sender.role`.

sender.description: Converger extension: who sent a persistent frame.

messageType.description: A message (renderer) type name. Lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

reservedFrameType.description: Frame types owned by the protocol (either direction). A rich message frame MUST NOT use one of these, except `text`. Superset of mekik/1 RESERVED_FRAME_TYPES.

metadata.description: Converger activity metadata (REST `channelData`). Stored with the activity; at most limits.maxMetadataBytes (16 KiB) as JSON.

meta.description: mekik/1 per-turn client context map, relayed to the conversation's bot channel; never stored.

extensions.description: Provider / vendor passthrough, keyed by a namespace (e.g. `whatsapp`, `telegram`, `x-acme`). Renderers ignore it. At most 8 KiB as JSON.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL, or a Converger attachment URL returned by the upload endpoint.

messageAction.description: A tappable chip / button. Union of chativa's MessageAction and mekik/1's: `value` omitted means the answer is `label`; `url` makes it a link. Outside interrupts, `value` SHOULD be a string (chativa sends it as the reply text).

errorCode.description: Stable string error codes. See docs/protocol/v1.md 'Error codes' for the numeric code and retryability of each.

aiChunk.description: A GenUI chunk, identical to mekik/1 and chativa AIChunk.

pendingView.description: An open interrupt as re-announced in welcome.data.pending (mekik/1 PendingView).
